world_facts: Hollowmere is a small river town in the year 1347, in a grim fantasy medieval world. Life is hard, people are frightened and superstitious, and the church, the watch and the tavern are the only order left. The church serves one pantheon of four gods, all known to be real: Caedros, god of death and mercy, to whom the chapel is built and who receives the dying; Yevra, broad and full-bodied, goddess of love, lust and childbearing, whom the goblins alone still worship openly; quick-tempered Agrath, goddess of storm and judgement, whose prayers are answered fastest and most cruelly; and cold Sevreth, goddess of the deep wood and changing shapes, whom even her own faithful are loath to name after dark. Their magic is old and rare, but real; everything else is only rumour and faith.
default_town_state: The plague has returned, the harvest has failed, and Lord Maelor has not left his keep in months.
